name: in-production
title: Hypermedia is already in production
html:
Hypermedia is already in production

Okta

The password expired, so the answer’s _links offer next: changePassword, and cancel. Nothing else. State, then controls, in one answer.

Amazon API Gateway

HAL with typed relations, in its current API reference. We’ll preview it as HEART shortly.

Spring HATEOAS, for agents

Adib Saikali (Broadcom), “REST is for Agents: Rediscovering Spring HATEOAS”, Spring I/O 2026.

What HEART adds: forms with JSON Schema, If-Match guards, typed relations, and only the forms that apply now.
say: Okta's Authentication API answers with HAL: _embedded for the user and policy, _links for what can be done next, here changePassword or cancel, because the password expired. Amazon API Gateway documents HAL with typed relations today; it gets previewed as HEART a few slides on. Spring HATEOAS is being pitched for agents now: Adib Saikali, Spring I/O 2026. What HEART adds: forms with JSON Schema, guards, and typed relations.
